title: Local unit representatives for a supplied abelian etale inverse image
statement: Let X and T be schemes [def-pc-scheme], p:T→X a morphism, H a functor from abelian etale sheaves on X to those on T [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and hH a specified adjunction H⊣p_* to the actual base-change pushforward [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For an abelian sheaf F on X and a section t of H(F) on the terminal etale T-object, there exist a possibly empty index set I in the scheme universe, etale T-objects Z_i, arrows z_i:Z_i→(T,id) whose generated sieve covers, etale X-objects W_i, arrows a_i:Z_i→p*W_i, and sections s_i∈F(W_i), such that H(F)(z_i)(t)=H(F)(a_i)(η_F(W_i)(s_i)) for all i, where η is the specified unit [def-pc-fibre-product]. No finiteness, affineness, stage, or compatibility on overlaps is claimed.

source.place: Lemma 59.39.2, local inverse-image representatives in the proof; abelian compatibility and adjunction from Proposition 7.44.3, Tag 00YV

proof.text: Construct the underlying lifted set presheaf, its pointwise left Kan extension P, and the comparison q induced by the supplied adjunction unit. The local-surjectivity theorem supplies a covering image sieve of the lifted section t.

For any arrow in the image sieve, choose its lift r to P. Types.jointly_surjective for the actual pointwise Kan cocone represents r by an index j and a lifted section b. The Kan-desc factorization equation identifies q after the Kan unit with the supplied unit. Naturality of q and the representative equation give the desired equality after restriction; applying ULift.down returns to the original coefficient universe. This uses only the representative clause of the Mathlib colimit element theorem, which does not require filteredness.

The small-etale topology criterion makes the covering image sieve jointly surjective on points of the terminal object. For every point choose an arrow containing it and its local representative. Indexing the family by these points gives I in Type (u+1). Every point is in the image of its own chosen arrow, so the generated sieve covers by Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff. On an empty scheme I is empty.

theorem etaleAbelian_local_unit_representatives
    {X T : Scheme.{u + 1}} (p : T ⟶ X)
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
      Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology T.smallEtaleTopology)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (t : (H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T)))) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Z : I → T.Etale)
      (z : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))
      (W : I → X.Etale) (a : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ p.Etale.obj (W i))
      (s : ∀ i, F.obj.obj (op (W i))),
      Sieve.ofArrows Z z ∈ T.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T)) ∧
      ∀ i, (H.obj F).obj.map (z i).op t =
        (H.obj F).obj.map (a i).op ((hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op (W i)) (s i))
